description: This file contains unit tests for the NavMenu component in a Blazor web application, verifying toggle behavior, authorized view rendering, and unauthorized view restrictions.

classes.name: NavMenuTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the NavMenu component, testing toggle functionality and authorization-based display logic.

methods.name: NavMenu_Toggle_Collapse_Class_Changes_On_Click
methods.description: Tests that clicking the toggle button collapses or expands the nav menu.

methods.name: NavMenu_Authorized_Shows_UserLinks_And_Active_Link_On_Admin
methods.description: Verifies that authorized users see relevant links and the admin link is active.

methods.name: NavMenu_Unauthorized_DoesNot_Show_Protected_Links
methods.description: Ensures that unauthenticated users do not see protected links like 'Logout' or account management.
